board.name: Sheikh Khalid Bin Rashid Al-Thani II
board.title: Non-Executive Director (QIA)

milestones.title: Pioneer Era Begins
milestones.description: Blacksand Oil Company Limited founded by Alhaji Ibrahim Alhassan CFR in Kano.

milestones.title: First Upstream Asset
milestones.description: Acquired first indigenous onshore exploration license (OML) in the Niger Delta Basin.

milestones.title: Domestic Infrastructure
milestones.description: Completed construction of a major national Storage and Product Depot in Kaduna.

milestones.title: Expansion Era & Landmark IPO
milestones.description: Abdallah Alhassan appointed GCEO. Blacksand Oil Company Plc. lists on the Nigerian Stock Exchange.

milestones.title: Offshore Entry
milestones.description: Entered offshore drilling operations and made the first oil discovery in the Okiri Deep Field.

milestones.title: Trading & Midstream
milestones.description: Established Blacksand Global Trading FZE in Dubai and Blacksand LNG Ltd.

milestones.title: Downstream Flagship
milestones.description: Commissioning of the first phase of the Blacksand Petrochemical Complex in Port Harcourt.

milestones.title: Leadership Transition
milestones.description: Samuel Esenbhalu appointed GCEO; Abdallah Alhassan becomes Non-Executive Chairman.

milestones.title: International Upstream M&A
milestones.description: Acquired 51% controlling interest in Azura E&P Angola Ltd. for $3.5 billion.

milestones.title: Middle East Expansion
milestones.description: Completed $6 billion greenfield Blacksand Fujairah Refining & Petrochemicals facility.

milestones.title: Corporate Rebranding
milestones.description: Name officially changed to Blacksand Plc., reflecting its multinational holding structure.

milestones.title: Globalization Era
milestones.description: Anwar Alhassan appointed Chairman. Company successfully navigated COVID-19.

milestones.title: Global Listing & Gas Expansion
milestones.description: Achieved landmark secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: BLSD). Acquired 60% stake in WestGas Infrastructure Ghana Ltd.

milestones.title: Logistics Alliance
milestones.description: Finalized the 45% strategic alliance with Helios Marine Logistics B.V.
